short.subject: Oppose Hakeem Jeffries as House Democratic Leader
short.body:
Dear Representative Bonamici,

I oppose Hakeem Jeffries' continued leadership of House Democrats and his selection as Speaker of the House.

Democrats deserve leadership that fights for universal healthcare, urgent climate action, and reduced military spending—not leadership beholden to corporate donors and pro-Israel lobbying interests. We also need leaders willing to dismantle ICE, support progressive candidates, and pursue meaningful structural change.

Jeffries' record has failed to meet these priorities. I urge you to support new House Democratic leadership, oppose Jeffries for Speaker, and make your position on his leadership clear.

detailed.subject: Opposition to Hakeem Jeffries as House Democratic Leader
detailed.body:
Dear Representative Bonamici,

I am writing to express my opposition to Hakeem Jeffries' continued leadership of House Democrats, including any future selection as Speaker of the House.

I believe Democratic voters deserve leadership that fights for universal healthcare, confronts the climate crisis with the urgency it demands, and meaningfully challenges the continued growth of Pentagon spending. In my assessment, Jeffries' record has fallen far short of those priorities.

I am also deeply concerned about Democratic leadership's relationship with corporate donors and pro-Israel lobbying organizations. I want leaders who are accountable to their constituents, not beholden to powerful donors and lobbying interests. On immigration, I support dismantling ICE and replacing it with a fundamentally different approach to immigration enforcement, rather than relying on incremental reforms.

Jeffries' approach to progressive candidates, his political strategy, and his poor public favorability ratings have further undermined my confidence in his ability to lead the party forward.

Changing leadership alone will not solve these problems. But continuing with the same leadership while expecting a fundamentally different direction is not an acceptable answer.

I believe House Democrats need new leadership that is more responsive to voters and willing to pursue meaningful structural change. I oppose Jeffries' selection as Speaker and want my elected officials to make their positions on his leadership clear.
